Flight Search API Without Per-Provider Integration — APIbase.pro apibase@prod ~ /srv/apibase/flight-search-intent APIbase.pro Pricing Catalog Connect Integrator Dashboard Contact Privacy Terms Moderation Frameworks Partners GitHub X Menu APIbase.pro Pricing Catalog Connect Integrator Dashboard Contact Privacy Terms Moderation Frameworks Partners GitHub X Flight search API without integrating individual providers Two flight-search providers, one endpoint, pay per call — no Sabre account, no Aviasales account, no per-provider key. Live tools Tool Price What it returns sabre.search_flights $0.01 Real-time flight offers with prices between two airports (Sabre GDS) aviasales.search_flights $0.005 Flights between two airports aviasales.cheap_flights $0.001 Cheapest flights from a single origin, no fixed destination sabre.destination_finder $0.005 Cheapest flight destinations from an origin airport, within a max fare sabre.airline_lookup $0.002 Airline details by IATA or ICAO code Prices and schemas above are a snapshot; the live, always-current entries are at /api/v1/tools (filter with ?category=travel ) or via GET /api/v1/discover?intent=search+flights . Why two providers instead of one Sabre is a GDS (global distribution system) with airline-direct fare data; Aviasales aggregates OTA pricing. They don't always agree on the cheapest fare for the same route — querying both from one endpoint costs a few cents in call fees instead of two separate signups, two separate credential sets, and two separate response shapes to normalize. How to call it curl -X POST https://apibase.pro/api/v1/tools/sabre.search_flights/call \ -H "Authorization: Bearer ak_live_..." \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"params": {"origin": "JFK", "destination": "LHR", "departure_date": "2026-11-01"}}' No API key yet? /connect covers all three ways to get one (or to skip getting one and pay directly from a wallet). A call without a payment header on a priced tool returns an HTTP 402 challenge with the exact price to sign, on either x402 (Base) or MPP (Tempo).
